prompt: Who was the Mayor of Quincy, Massachusetts when the Quincy Medical Center opened and who was the Mayor when it closed?
answer:
Quincy Medical Center opened in **1890**, when **Henry O. Fairbanks** was mayor of Quincy.

It closed on **December 26, 2014**, during the tenure of **Thomas P. Koch**.
